records.title: EXPANSION OF PNG AND CNG INFRASTRUCTURE IN GUJARAT
details:
In the state of Gujarat, PNGRB has authorized 32 Geographical Areas (GAs) (including 1 GA spread 
over Daman and Diu (UT) & Gujarat, and 1 GA spread over Gujarat & Maharashtra) covering entire 
state of Gujarat (including urban and semi-urban areas) for development of CGD network with 
Minimum Work Programme (MWP) target of 47,53,332 PNG domestic connections, 210 CNG 
stations & 1,10,600 Inch-KM of pipeline to be completed by December 2028.

records.title: IMPLEMENTATION AND ASSESSMENT OF PMSGMBY
details:
The PMSG: MBY launched in February, 2024, aims to achieve RTS installations in one
crore households, adding 30 GW solar capacity in the residential sector by FY 2026-27, with
an outlay of Rs 75,021 crore.
